job: Read one wide-reaching change in full, preview who it touches, and ship or decline it with a held commit.
purpose: One case on its own page, opened from a link or a notification: a lifecycle tracker of its sign-offs, the brief, the full evidence (a table of the test and a timeline), then preview-then-commit: choose the scope, preview "29 teams change", write the reason and ship with a 10-second inline hold. Once decided the brief keeps its parts and ends with who decided, the reason, the audit line and an Undo that is itself held. A side panel holds the case facts.
useWhen: A change reaches many teams or records, and its reach depends on what the person chooses.
A decision is linked from a notification, an email or the queue, and must stand on its own page.

avoidWhen.when: Several small cases wait for the same person and none needs a preview.
The person is not signed in and answers from an email.
The page describes an entity, not a decision about it.

states.name: waiting
states.how: the default: tracker step data-state="waiting", fd-preview ready

states.name: stale preview
states.how: fd-preview data-state="stale" after a field changes

states.name: held
states.how: fd-commit data-fd-hold="10": the inline fd-hold counts down with Undo
